configuration: The body texts are document_cache's body_text, as IndexingPipeline.fetchDocumentBodyText reads it, from an index the app's own pipeline builds of the three fixture volumes in a scratch folder (IndexingPipeline(fts5Store:databaseURL:volumesDirectory:resources:defaults:) with the submodule's FRUSExplorer/Resources and an in-memory stamp store, indexVolume for each volume in sorted order), every document with a body text, in the index's order. Each text is walked as the pinned WordCloudTokenizer walks one for a part-of-speech lens: a new tagger from NaturalLanguageReadiness.tagger(tagSchemes: [.lemma, .lexicalClass]), its string set and English pinned over the whole text, enumerateTags by .word with NaturalLanguageReadiness.wordWalkScheme(of:), which must be .lemma, omitting punctuation, whitespace and other tokens; each word's lemma the walk's tag, none when it is missing or empty, and its class the .lexicalClass tag at the word's first character. Offsets count Unicode scalars. A release build of the app module, with testing enabled, compiled from the submodule unmodified.
